findings.evidence: `rg "covariance_eq_of_ne|covariance_eq_of_lt|off-diagonal"` finds only `Contractable.covariance_eq_of_lt` and the headline conjunct at lines 126 and 144; roadmap lines 422-423 request pair covariances and the uniform covariance structure, not only ordered pairs.
findings.fix: Add a public `Contractable.covariance_eq_of_ne` using `Contractable.covariance_eq_of_lt` plus `covariance_comm`, and expose the headline third conjunct as `∀ i j k l, i ≠ j → k ≠ l → cov[X i, X j; μ] = cov[X k, X l; μ]`.
findings.issue: `contractable_covariance_structure` characterizes covariances only under `i < j` and `k < l`, although the roadmap asks for the uniform covariance structure and the docstring says a single common off-diagonal covariance.

summary: The covariance API stops short of the advertised off-diagonal structure: it only exposes increasing pairs, leaving the natural unordered off-diagonal form missing for later L² block-average sums.
